conditional_recovery_limitations: Case values are Swift ABI runtime tags, with payload cases before empty cases; field names are reflection metadata. Valid enum values supply the bound; this does not establish state reachability or original source order.

swift-dynamic-typed-snapshot-v1: conditional on a recursively valid active outer value at the exact runtime tag call, stable ABI layout and imported-call/GOT bindings during the prefix (no interposition/mutation), live/disjoint stack regions, nonwrapping monotonic allocations and a stable checked post-tag window. Pre-tag nonescape, preceding copy/ownership and later lifetime semantics are not proved.

Darwin stack-probe effects assume trusted-darwin-arm64-chkstk-v1 on normal return. Import identity does not establish Arc's runtime binding, absence of interposition, nonfaulting reads or completed allocation.
remaining_native_limitations: Unresolved computed or indirect flows without target addresses are not represented as reference edges.
Thunk and external classifications are Ghidra FunctionManager observations; they do not resolve targetless calls.
Pseudocode and assembly are Ghidra-specific representations, not original source or Hopper-equivalent text.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
